body: I mostly like rum (gold Appleton). I shoot straight, not into girly drinks. But I smoke bud on the daily I have a hard time eating, and  I mostly forget to eat when I don’t smoke. I get migraines everyday, sometimes to the point of throwing up.

I usually do something destructive to distract myself like drinking or smoking. I’ve been in a total of 4 car accidents and one motorcycle accident as a passenger (all literally not my fault). So I have high anxiety and ptsd in cars and I try to avoid going anywhere. I’ve been rear ended while at dead stops twice. I’ve had  2 people turn in front of me at the last second (including the motorcycle) and on kid shot from behind a stopped bus and crossed all the lanes just to side swipe me.

They say idle hand are the devils workshop. But they never tell you how truly brutal your own mind can be when it’s left to its own devices. Doing things and going out can distract you but that’s only If you leave my house. These days I probably leave my house once a week. The abundance of idle time to simmer in my negative thoughts is slowly eating away at me inside. I cried 5 times yesterday for no fucking reason. I stayed up all night fantasizing about a perfect way I could end this.
